free_tier.stated: [translated] 'VPS Plan v20: $0.54 USD per month. vCPU 1 core, memory 512 MB, disk 20 GB, traffic: pay per traffic, network: NAT, location: South Korea.' No free tier appears on the page.

egress.terms: [translated] 'Traffic: pay per traffic', priced from the vendor's pricing document. No monthly allowance is included; data is billed as used.; ingress: udp

interface_detail: [translated] 'Create your WireGuard server by oneclick', 'Access your shadowsocks server by oneclick' - the panel builds the server image.
tooling: one-click Shadowsocks, WireGuard and OpenVPN images plus a custom VPS; SSH on a NAT-forwarded port
chaining: At USD 0.54 per month for a Korean guest it is the cheap fallback for a Korean endpoint if a free one never appears.
binding_note: Nothing free binds. Traffic is billed per byte on a NAT guest, so the first failure at 1 TiB/month is the invoice, not a quota.

identity_cost.detail: The page's 'Create' links land on somagu.com/vps/create/...; no signup requirements are stated on the page read, so email-or-card is not established either way.

reliability_note: Contention on a NAT guest and pay-per-traffic billing.
confidence_note: The price, the NAT network and the one-click WireGuard product are vendor sentences with a date. Whether the NAT address accepts an inbound UDP handshake is not stated and would need a probe; the record cannot be raised without one.

evidence.proved: [translated] 'VPS Plan v20: $0.54 USD per month', 'Traffic: pay per traffic', 'Network: NAT', 'Location: South Korea'.
[translated] 'WireGuard $0.54 USD/m - VPS Plan v20 (1 vCPU + 512 MB) - WireGuard Server - Create your WireGuard server by oneclick.'

notes: This is the cheapest Korean address found and the only one that builds a WireGuard server in one click, but it is paid and the network is NAT with no stated port mapping. History worth knowing: Somagu ran a free 512 MB NAT VPS in 2017 (announced by the same operator who runs Mudfish), and search results quote a forum post announcing the service would end on 2023-08-31. The live pricing page on 2026-10-23 sells plans, so the shutdown notice is either reversed or refers to the free tier. The forum page itself did not render that text to this reader, so the quote is a search snippet and is not trusted. Country: South Korea.

extras.wg_detail: [translated] The vendor builds the endpoint for you: 'WireGuard $0.54 USD/m - VPS Plan v20 (1 vCPU + 512 MB) - WireGuard Server - Create your WireGuard server by oneclick.' The network is NAT, and no public port or port-forward count is stated for this plan.
extras.volume_stated: [translated] 'Traffic: pay per traffic', priced from the vendor's pricing document. No monthly allowance is included; data is billed as used.
extras.transit_note: A NAT guest behind the operator's Korean address; the shared address carries the bytes.
